main_text.l: currus, Ovid. Alipes equus, Virg. Ales equus, Ovid. Pegasus ales, Hor. Pennipes, Catul. Præpes victoria, Ausón. i. e. pennata.) (Prisci enim victoriam pinxere pennatam.) Pterotos calix, Plin. :/: ansatus.
Albare] Dealbare, Cic. Inalbare, Apul. Incretare, Petron. Candidare, Pompon. Candificare, Næv. Candefacere, Plaut.
Albedo] Albitudo, Plaut. Albor, Var. Candor nivis, Virg.
Albere] Albicare, Plin. Inalbere, Apul. Candicare, Plin. Candet ebur, Catul. Canescit flos, Plin. Canet herba gelu, Sil.
Albidus] Albidulus, Pallad. Exalbidus. Subalbidus, Plin. Subalbicans, Var. Albineus color equi, Pallad.
Alburnum] Adeps arboris. Caro arboris. Pulpa arboris, Plin.
Alea] Sonat alea fritillis, Mart. Tessera, Cic. Jacere tesseras. Numeri eburni, Ovid. Lepusculi. Jacula, Isid.
Aleator] Aleo, Fest. Deditissimus aleæ, Suet. Aleâ lendi artifex, Plutar. Tesserarius, Amm. Effusus in lusum.

Alembicum] Æolipyla, Vitruv. (ἡ αἰολικπύλη, quasi venti porta, Philord. Cardan.) Vesica metallica, Matthiol. Clibanus, Bud. Turbo, Jun. Meta furnaria, Id. Nola vitrea. Conceptaculum, Cardan. Diploma, Caes. Jun. Balneum maris, Offic. Balneum Mariæ, Cardan. & Matthio.

Alere] Nutrire, Ovid. Pax nutrit Cererem. Sustentare, Cic. Sustineo milites piscæ, Liv. Educat aliquem ager, Martial. Alere & majus facere aliquid, Cic. Alere facundiam, vires augere eloquentiæ, Quint. Memoriam, ingeniumque assidua exercitatio alit. Corporis vires labor modicus alit. Lenis alit flammas, grandior aura necat, Ovid.
Alescere] Alescendo roborari, Var. Adolescere, Tacit.
Alga] Fucus marinus. Alga marina, Plin. Theriaca maris, Plin.
Alias] Sed de hoc alias, Cic. (Alteras, pro alias, Fest. priscum)

page.notes: Catchword and signature absent. Greek in "Æolipyla" entry transcribed as printed; the Greek word "αἰολικπύλη" is uncertain [?]. Line "Alea lendi" reads "Aleâ ludendi" as printed in the scan.
